checkins.beer_name: Pump Up the Jam - Strawberry & Cream

checkins.checkin_comment: Oh, wow! This is fantastic. Christmas cakeish, cinnamon, possibly nutmeg. This is great.
Love it. And the artwork on the beer tap - sensational! I remember those photos from my grandmas house.
Quality but spiced just edged it.
Great beer! Excellent flavour - love it.
7.6% of danger. The spice is outstanding

Cold fermented, then buried under hazelnut and coconut like it’s hiding from responsibility. Rich, indulgent, and absolutely not here to help you make good decisions. This is less a drink, more a lifestyle choice.
Three countries walk into a glass and immediately outshine the conversation. Big, juicy, and showing off from every angle, less a balanced act, more a full-blown international incident of flavour.

Looks like midnight, drinks like a hop bomb. Roast and caramel doing their best to behave while citrus and pine kick the door in. Bitterness sticks around like that mate who said “just one” three rounds ago.

checkins.beer_name: King Peanut Fresh Hop Golden Ale

checkins.checkin_comment: Starts all warm and inviting, then quietly sharpens the knife. Toffee and plum playing nice until the hops stir trouble, like a card game where someone’s definitely cheating but no one wants to call it out.

All hail the cat overlord, finally a ruler I can get behind. Fruity, a bit biscuity, and far more balanced than anything happening on this rooftop. If Peanut’s in charge, I’m staying for another round.

checkins.beer_name: Where the Wild Things Are - Maleny (2025)

checkins.checkin_comment: Nightcap with a bit of swagger. Rich dark malt wrapped in vanilla, toffee and dark fruit from the cask. Smooth, warming, and just complex enough to make me nod thoughtfully like I planned this all along.

Only one is required...ABV... and price! 😱

Fuckng delicious though! ❤️
So good. I miss the feijoa flavour!
Very active grape ale. Bitter af! Great!
